title.zh: 民事清单与酬金法 1970——议会会议通过的决议
title.en: Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970 — Resolution Passed at Parliament Meeting

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970
It is notified for general information that the following resolution was passed at a meeting of Parliament on 6 March 2023:
“That this Parliament, pursuant to section 7 of the Civil List and Gratuity Act 1970, resolves that the Schedule to that Act be varied by deleting the figures “$4,532,400” and “$2,762,300” in the second column and substituting for them the figures “$6,696,700” and “$3,342,200” respectively.”.
